sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that in this case he is innocent and has committed no offence.
The victim was major at the time of alleged incident and was consensuous.
It is further submitted that when dispute arose between the parties she lodged the present F.I.R. with false allegations.
The trial court while passing the impugned order did not take into account the facts and evidence available on record in right perspective and erred in passing the same.
Appellant is in jail since 06.11.2024, having no criminal history.
It is lastly submitted that the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant suffers from infirmity and illegality warranting interference by this Court.
On the other hand, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail.
I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned A.G.A. and have gone through the entire record including the impugned order carefully.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the period of appellant remained in jail having no any criminal antecedent, the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C., her age and consensuous and without making any further comment on the merit of the case,
this Court is of the opinion that the appellant has made out a case for bail.
The Court below erred in rejecting the bail application.
The impugned order suffers from infirmity and illegality and the same is liable to be set-aside and the appeal is to be allowed.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

Let the appellant Mohammad Rais @ Rahees involved in Case Crime No. 366 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504, 506, 420 of I.P.C. and section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act, (Mohd. Rais @ Rahees Vs.
State of U.P.), lodged at Police Station Loni Katra, District Barabanki be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
